what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.hook: Special Town Meeting warrant articles, a possible Finance Reserve request tied to reconciling the FY26 school budget, and a Net School Spending workshop
preview.how_to_attend: In-person at the Bilotta Meeting Room, Town Hall; or remotely via Zoom (webinar link/ID and call-in number printed on the agenda)

items.agenda_line: a. Draft Special Town Meeting Warrant Articles
items.why_it_matters: These draft articles would set what voters are asked to decide at the next Special Town Meeting, which can include spending or bylaw changes.

items.agenda_line: b. Future Request for Finance Reserve Funding – Reconciliation of FY26 School Dept budget and Review of FY27 school budget and financial operations
items.why_it_matters: The committee may discuss drawing on the town's finance reserve fund to address a school budget reconciliation, which would affect town finances and school operations.
Net School Spending is the state-mandated minimum the town must budget for schools, so a workshop on it concerns school funding requirements.

items.agenda_line: d. Potential Topics for future Tri-Board Meetings
items.why_it_matters: This sets the agenda for future joint meetings among town boards, which could later address budget or policy matters.
Changes to the town's financial policies can affect how money is managed and spent going forward.

preview.one_line: Finance Committee, Sept 24, 7 PM: draft Special Town Meeting warrant articles, a possible Finance Reserve request tied to the FY26 school budget, and a Net School Spending workshop.
preview.where: Bilotta Meeting Room, Lunenburg Town Hall

Finance Committee meets Thursday September 24 at 7:00 PM.

Special Town Meeting warrant articles, a possible Finance Reserve request tied to reconciling the FY26 school budget, and a Net School Spending workshop.

On the agenda: a. Draft Special Town Meeting Warrant Articles; b. Future Request for Finance Reserve Funding – Reconciliation of FY26 School Dept budget and Review of FY27 school budget and financial operations; c. Net School Spending workshop; d. Potential Topics for future Tri-Board Meetings.

In-person at the Bilotta Meeting Room, Town Hall; or remotely via Zoom (webinar link/ID and call-in number printed on the agenda)
